title: Random Walk in Random Environment: A short introduction
abstract: This is a report of a scientific project carried out at Ecole Centrale Casablanca in 2019. This work is an entry into the world of Random Walk in a Random Environment (RWRE). We will discuss some intuitive concepts such as recurrence, location, and random potential. We will thereafter focus on providing an "electrical" understanding of this type of walk and finally explore an application of RWRE to graphene conduction.
